metadata.title: Mass Deficits, Stalling Radii, and the Merger Histories of Elliptical Galaxies

notes: No eligible stars. The paper is a theoretical study of binary supermassive black holes and nuclear mass deficits; it does not identify individual Galactic stars or assess any star as an unbound candidate. Its mention of Milky Way hyper-velocity stars at T:p10-b3 is an unnamed population cited as a possible consequence of a Galactic-center binary, with no individual names or source identifiers. The NGC objects in Table 3 (T:p9-b0) are galaxies, not stars.
